question: A person borrows Rs. 5,000 for 2 years at 4% p.a. simple interest. He immediately lends it to another person at (25)/(4) % p.a. for 2 years. Find his gain (in Rs.) in the transaction
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5000

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate of interest (borrowed) = 4% p.a.

Rate of interest (lent) = 25/4% p.a.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

Gain = Interest received - Interest paid

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (5000 times 4 times 2)/(100)

⇒ SI = ₹400

⇒ SI = ₹625

⇒ Gain = ₹625 - ₹400

⇒ Gain = ₹225

**∴ The gain in the transaction is ₹225.**
